notes.title: Nuts has been moved to Unity, CPU usage reduced by 99% - Trade Up Contracts Soon
notes.notes:
Given the feedback from the community and a few ounces of logical thought, we have migrated Nuts to Unity. Doing so has reduced the CPU and GPU usage by 99% and has reduced the file size from 350mb to only 24mb

The OG drop tables will be extended for an additional 24 hours to compensate those who could not run the previous build. 

Thank you all for your feedback and patience!

Nut Hard and Prosper
